title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on John 8: the woman brought to Jesus in the temple, the light of the world, and the dispute about Abraham.

questions.text: Where did Jesus sit down and teach the people very early in the morning?
questions.explanation: Very early in the morning he came again into the temple, all the people came to him, and he sat down and taught them.

answers.text: In a boat on the lake

questions.text: Whom did the scribes and the Pharisees bring to Jesus and set in the middle?
questions.explanation: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery and set her in the middle.

answers.text: A man who could not walk

questions.text: What did Jesus do while they were testing him with their question?
questions.explanation: They asked to have something to accuse him of, but Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

answers.text: He read aloud from the law
He wrote on the ground with his finger
He prayed with his hands lifted up

questions.text: Who did Jesus say should throw the first stone at her?
questions.explanation: He looked up and said that the one among them who is without sin should throw the first stone at her.

answers.text: The one who had found her
The judges who knew the law
The one among them who is without sin

questions.text: In what order did her accusers leave?
questions.explanation: When they heard it, they were convicted by their conscience and went out one by one, beginning from the oldest.

answers.text: One by one, beginning from the oldest
The scribes first, then the Pharisees

questions.text: What did Jesus call himself when he spoke to them again?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that he is the light of the world, and that whoever follows him will not walk in the darkness.

questions.text: According to Jesus, what does their law say about valid testimony?
questions.explanation: He said it is written in their law that the testimony of two people is valid.

answers.text: The testimony of two people is valid

questions.text: What did Jesus say the truth would do for those who remain in his word?
questions.explanation: He said that they would know the truth, and that the truth would make them free.

questions.text: Who did Jesus say was the father of those who wanted to kill him?
questions.explanation: Jesus told them that they are of their father, the devil, who was a murderer from the beginning and is the father of lies.

questions.text: What did they do after Jesus said, "before Abraham came into existence, I AM"?
questions.explanation: They took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple through the middle of them.

answers.text: They put him out of the synagogue
They took up stones to throw at him
They led him away to Pilate
